Meet El Triangulo Latino

A Dominican home away from home

El Triangulo Latino is a family-owned Dominican restaurant in Lancaster, PA, serving since 2013. In the restaurant's own words, it serves fresh, made-to-order dishes.

The menu runs to mofongo, pernil, lomo saltado, camaron guisado, and pechurina, sandwiches including the Cubano and jamon y queso, ceviche de camaron, and biscocho in guava and pina. Dine in, or call for takeout.
